answer_1.quote: Given an audio file, the goal of AS systems is to generate a subtitle file composed of subtitle blocks, each of which includes a piece of translated text and the corresponding start and end timestamps.
answer_1.outputs: Generated subtitles (translated text with timing and segmentation)
